evals.prompt: This repo has no README.md. Write one. Use the make-readme skill /make-readme.
evals.expected_output: Ran scripts/inspect_repo.py, classified the project type, wrote README.md from README_TEMPLATE.md with no leftover INSTRUCTIONS or {{placeholders}}, and listed assumptions instead of inventing license, Discord, or benchmark facts.
expectations: Runs python3 scripts/inspect_repo.py against the target repo
Does not invent license, Discord, or benchmark numbers missing from the repo
Does not link CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, LICENSE, or images that are not on disk
Deletes INSTRUCTIONS comment blocks and {{placeholders}} before shipping

evals.prompt: Improve the existing README.md. Keep its working badges and voice. Use make-readme.
evals.expected_output: Ran scripts/score_readme.py first, then edited section by section; preserved existing badges, community links, troubleshooting, and voice; reported before/after scores.
expectations: Runs python3 scripts/score_readme.py on the existing README
Defaults to improve mode when a README is already present
Keeps working badges, real community links, and the author's voice
Does not replace the file wholesale from the template

evals.prompt: Score this README only. Do not rewrite it. Review /make-readme.
evals.expected_output: Ran scripts/score_readme.py and reported CRITICAL/IMPORTANT/MINOR findings. Did not write README.md.
expectations: Uses review mode: inspect and score only
Reports score and exact fixes from the linter
